nodes.title: SG-5.2 · Rebuild StoryPanel on the kit
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/components/StoryPanel.tsx is a plain list of h1, dialogue, history ol and inventory ul. App.tsx passes sceneTitle, node, history, inventory and onChoose from useGame. Desired behavior: the panel is rebuilt on the frame kit (sf-frame-* classes in styles.css) with its own overflow scroll, a 32x32 portrait in the dialogue card, a 3x2 inventory grid with icons and names, and an event log. Expected result: all regions read real game state. Why: matches the reference UI.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a dialogue node, when StoryPanel renders, then the chapter title, a parchment card with portrait, speaker name and line, and one button per choice are shown.
- Given an inventory of 0 to 6 items, when rendered, then exactly 6 slots appear in a 3x2 grid, filled slots show icon and name, empty slots are marked empty.
- Given history lines, when rendered, then the event log lists them in order inside a region that scrolls independently.
- Given a choice click, then onChoose is called with that choice index.


## Scope
- In scope: StoryPanel component and its pure data helper
- In scope: existing story, title and frame-kit tests
- Out of scope: new story content
- Out of scope: new rooms
- Out of scope: backend changes
- Out of scope: audio
- Out of scope: header changes
- Preserve: StoryPanelProps contract used by App
- Preserve: aria-labels Dialogue, Story history, Inventory
- Preserve: Go API contracts and contribution flow


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays on 3.90.x; React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Radix, Zustand stay.
- No mock data in place of real API calls; data comes from game state and the manifest.
- Art is generated PNG from the repo; no downloaded art or CDN links.
- One shared palette of at most 48 colours used by art and UI.
- Tests are unit tests with all dependencies mocked.


## Definition of done
- All acceptance criteria met
- Updated and new unit tests pass


## Non-functional requirements
- Layout holds from 1280x720; panel works as bottom drawer on narrow screens


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Panel shows chapter title and a parchment dialogue card with portrait, speaker, line and choices
nodes.body:
Context: StoryPanel renders the dialogue as bare h2, p and buttons without a portrait. Desired behavior: wrap the panel in sf-frame-panel with own overflow-y scroll, show the chapter title, and render the node in an sf-frame-parchment card with the speaker portrait resolved from the manifest. Expected result: card shows portrait, speaker, line and choices list. Why: reference UI.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a node with speaker boy, when rendered, then an img of 32x32 from manifest id character:boy-portrait is in the Dialogue region.
- Given a speaker with no manifest portrait, when rendered, then no img is shown and the speaker name and line still render.
- Given a node with 2 choices, when rendered, then a list with 2 buttons appears and clicking the second calls onChoose(1).
- Given no node, when rendered, then the title shows and no Dialogue region exists.


## Scope
- In scope: root frame and overflow classes
- In scope: dialogue card
- In scope: choices list
- In scope: portrait lookup helper
- Out of scope: inventory
- Out of scope: event log content
- Preserve: story-content root class
- Preserve: aria-label Dialogue


## Technical constraints
- Portrait comes from the existing generated manifest entry character:boy-portrait.
- Palette and tokens shared with UI; no new colours.


## Dependencies
- INT


## Definition of done
- Dialogue card renders portrait, speaker, line, choices
- Root panel is framed and scrolls on its own


## Non-functional requirements
- Portrait uses pixelated rendering


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Inventory is a 3x2 grid of slots with item icons and names, empty slots included
nodes.body:
Context: inventory renders a ul of ids or the text Empty. Desired behavior: a grid of exactly six sf-frame-slot cells, 3 columns by 2 rows; each filled slot shows the 16x16 icon from manifest id item/<id> and a readable name; remaining slots are empty placeholders. Expected result: layout is stable at any inventory size up to six.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given inventory ['old-key'], then 6 slots render, slot 1 has an img from item/old-key and the name 'Old Key', 5 slots are marked empty.
- Given empty inventory, then 6 empty slots render and no img exists.
- Given an item with no manifest icon, then its name shows without an img.
- Grid has 3 columns (grid-cols-3).


## Scope
- In scope: inventory grid
- In scope: slot builder helper
- Out of scope: more than six items scrolling rules
- Out of scope: new item art
- Preserve: aria-label Inventory
- Preserve: item icon PNGs and manifest entries


## Technical constraints
- Icons come from existing generated item/* manifest entries.
- Shared palette and tokens only.


## Dependencies
- INT


## Definition of done
- Always six slots
- Icons and names from game state


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Event log renders game history in its own scrolling region and App feeds real state
nodes.body:
Context: history renders as a bare ol. Desired behavior: a framed Event log region showing history entries in order (newest visible via scroll) with a max-height scroll, and App continues to pass game.state.history, inventory and choose from useGame with no leftover old styling. Expected result: log reflects game state changes after choices.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given history ['a','b'], then the Story history list shows a then b inside an sf-frame-plaque region.
- Given empty history, then the log shows the text 'Nothing has happened yet'.
- Given App rendered after Begin, then StoryPanel receives the game state's history, inventory and choose and old border-amber/bg-stone-900 classes are gone.


## Scope
- In scope: event log markup
- In scope: App wiring check
- Out of scope: new log persistence
- Out of scope: backend
- Preserve: aria-label Story history
- Preserve: App props


## Technical constraints
- Real game state only; no mocked data.


## Dependencies
- INT


## Definition of done
- Log reads from state; no legacy styling


## Clarifying questions
- None
